title: The Zurich Urban Micro Aerial Vehicle (MAV) Dataset
drone: Fotokite tethered quadrotor MAV, GoPro Hero 4 camera (not a DJI product)
subject: downtown Zurich, Switzerland street canyon -- camera kept facing building facades while flying low (5-15 m AGL) along ~2 km of urban streets
known_dimension: on-board calibration checkerboard target used for the MAV camera: 9x7 squares, 2.45 cm per square -- a precise, published physical scale reference (Majdik et al. 2017, Calibration section); no single building dimension is published
notes: Real drone image sequence (not a single video file): 81,169 time-synced JPEG images at 30 Hz, 1920x1080x24-bit, captured Jan 2015, downloadable directly as a 200MB sample (AGZ_subset.zip, confirmed HTTP 206 on ranged request) or full 28GB set (AGZ.zip), no download form/login required. Includes on-board GPS, IMU, Pixhawk pose log, and a photogrammetrically-computed (Pix4D) ground-truth flight path with stated 2.2-5.5 m RMS geo-location error -- this is the strongest telemetry/known-scale entry in the corpus. duration_s (2706s ~= 45 min) is derived from image_count/frame_rate (81169/30Hz) and matches the paper's stated '45 minutes of non-stop flight', not a single stated field -- flagged as inferred. Not a top-down orbit of one tall building; most useful for facade/SfM-matching and scale-calibration testing rather than mesh-of-one-building testing.
